title: agent.blueprint_reloaded payload
description: A blueprint was reloaded from disk (api-contracts.md 2.3.9, contracts.md C-11). content_hash is what tells an edit apart from a version bump.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalised blueprint (ADR-015 p. 1) in the form sha256:<64 lowercase hex> (contracts.md C-07 v1.3), carried as a string and never as a number, for the reason spelled out in agent.spawned.v1.json: a JSON number is read back as a float64 and a hash does not survive it.
